existing_tips: "I fjärran" = in the distance (literary). "Hördes" = was heard (s-passive).
"Sommarens" = summer's (genitive -s). Possessive -s works like English apostrophe-s.
"Presenteras" – s-passive is dominant in Swedish academic writing. Impersonal style.
